whenToUse: Bookings by the hour, such as a hair salon, clinic, or consultation.
There are about ten slots a day.
whenNotToUse: Any time can be set (use a time picker).
There are a great many slots (split them into morning and afternoon).
People need to choose several consecutive times.

alternatives.name: Time Picker
alternatives.reason: Setting a time regardless of availability.

accessibility: Each time is a native radio, moved with the arrow keys, and the fieldset legend gives the date.
Full times are disabled and show "Full" in words.
Put the chosen time in the booking button's name ("Book 11:00").
Announce the booking result with role="status".
